prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: cover illustration for a 16:9 engineering presentation titled How Anthropic builds with AI. The title will be typeset separately.
Primary request: a refined sculptural metaphor for an engineering workshop where many small automated units build a precise architectural system under human direction.
Scene/backdrop: warm ivory studio floor and background, seamless.
Subject: a beautiful tabletop architectural maquette with terracotta clay arches, deep aubergine structural beams, brushed brass rails, and tiny pale porcelain blocks traveling through the structure. No literal robots, no screens, no people.
Style/medium: tactile high-end editorial still life, finely crafted physical materials, realistic soft shadows, gently surreal architecture.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 16:9. All substantial sculpture concentrated in the right 52 percent. The left 45 percent is calm empty ivory space for a large readable title. The sculpture is large, artful, asymmetric and fills most of the right side without clipping.
Lighting/mood: soft directional late-afternoon studio light, calm, intelligent, understated.
Color palette: warm ivory, burnt terracotta, ink aubergine, muted brass.
Constraints: no letters, numbers, symbols, logos, watermarks, charts, dashboards or infographics. Not a photograph of a real workplace. Keep the left half nearly empty.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 16:9 editorial slide illustration, verification theme, text will be typeset separately
Primary request: a sculptural still life about verifying that a precisely made part actually fits.
Scene/backdrop: seamless warm ivory plaster studio surface.
Subject: one carefully made terracotta arch, a porcelain rectangular gauge passing cleanly through its opening, and a large elegant brushed brass precision caliper resting alongside it. These are beautiful simple physical objects, with believable contact shadows and subtle surface texture. No measuring markings.
Style/medium: premium architectural maquette photography, tactile clay and milled metal, surreal yet plausible, elegant editorial art.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 16:9. Objects occupy the rightmost 45 percent, with generous blank warm ivory space throughout the left half for the slide's content. Entire objects visible and well within the edges.
Lighting/mood: warm directional soft studio lighting.
Color palette: terracotta, ivory, muted brass with a small aubergine accent.
Constraints: no text, logos, watermarks, diagrams, infographics, robots, screens, people or glyphs. The scene is a conceptual illustration, not a real workshop.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full-bleed 16:9 conceptual editorial illustration for an engineering slide about bounded autonomy
Primary request: a beautiful miniature automated architectural workshop protected inside a clear thick glass enclosure, showing freedom of movement within firm physical limits.
Scene/backdrop: dark aubergine studio surface and seamless background.
Subject: a single substantial cylindrical clear-glass enclosure on a low dark plinth, containing three small terracotta architectural blocks and a curved muted-brass rail. Glass edges sharply defined by elegant reflections. The structure feels precise, finite and calm.
Style/medium: premium architectural still-life photography, realistic glass, handmade clay, brushed metal, restrained editorial art.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape. Enclosure and all visible objects contained in right 45 percent. Left 50 percent plain very dark aubergine negative space reserved for large cream slide text. Keep objects entirely inside the frame.
Lighting/mood: dramatic but soft, amber edge lighting, no glowing sci-fi effects.
Color palette: ink aubergine #29232D, terracotta, ivory, subdued brass.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, icons, watermarks, logos, robots, people, screens, charts or diagrams. Conceptual illustration, not a real facility.
